I couldn't cancel the Brightline vendor call (today, 3:00–3:45pm) because Alex Moreno at Brightline organized it, and only the organizer can cancel it. I declined it for you instead. Alex was notified and got this note: "Sorry, I can't make today's call. I'll follow up to reschedule."

The event may still be on Jordan Blake's calendar and Alex's. If you want to propose a new time, I can draft that email.
